moves.label: Shadow Clone Jab
moves.description: Fast high clone jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact Naruto hand strike from the Shadow Clone Strike animation.

moves.label: Uzumaki Barrage Kick
moves.description: Fast high kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Short aerial kick from the Uzumaki Barrage frames.

moves.label: Quick Rasengan Palm
moves.description: Fast high Rasengan palm with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Orange chakra palm arc matches the Rasengan animation.

moves.label: Rasenshuriken Arc
moves.description: Quick mid Rasenshuriken arc with a short active window and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Spinning orange chakra arc matches the Rasenshuriken frames.

moves.label: Rasengan Pop-Up
moves.description: Fast high launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Upward Rasengan arc is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Clone Upper Barrage
moves.description: Fast high launcher with a moderate active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Clone-assisted rising strike has launcher data.

moves.label: Rasenshuriken Smash
moves.description: Quick mid knockdown smash with a brief active chakra arc.
moves.reason: Mid Rasenshuriken arc is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Low Clone Hop
moves.description: Quick low jumping strike with a brief active window and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Low hopping kick visibly leaves the ground.

moves.label: Rasenshuriken Step
moves.description: Quick mid chakra step with a moderate active window and very fast recovery.
moves.reason: Stepping Rasenshuriken-style arc stays mid.

moves.label: Homing Low Sweep
moves.description: Fast low homing sweep that knocks down and ends Naruto crouched.
moves.reason: Low flame-trail sweep has homing, knockdown, and crouch-end data.

moves.label: Low Uzumaki Kick
moves.description: Fast low kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down command reuses a low Uzumaki Barrage kick.

moves.label: Crouching Clone Combo
moves.description: Quick mid crouching combo with extended active chakra coverage.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence includes clone impact and Rasenshuriken-style arc.

moves.label: Crouch Rasengan Pop-Up
moves.description: Fast high launcher with a brief Rasengan pop-up from crouch.
moves.reason: Full-crouch Rasengan hit is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Full-Crouch Low Kick
moves.description: Fast low kick with a short active window that ends Naruto crouched.
moves.reason: Two-frame full-crouch kick is low, homing, and crouch-ending.

moves.label: Crouch Rasenshuriken
moves.description: Quick mid Rasenshuriken sweep with a short active window and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Full-crouch command uses the Rasenshuriken arc sequence.

moves.label: Low Rasenshuriken Feint
moves.description: Quick low homing feint that ends Naruto in full crouch.
moves.reason: Two-frame full-crouch Rasenshuriken variant is low and crouch-ending.

moves.label: Overdrive Clone Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Overdrive command reuses the compact clone jab.

moves.label: Rasengan Knockdown Drive
moves.description: Steady mid Rasengan drive that knocks down after a short active burst.
moves.reason: Overdrive Rasengan rush is authored as knockdown.

moves.label: Overdrive Rasenshuriken Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid Rasenshuriken tornado with a short active window and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Overdrive Rasenshuriken carries tornado data.

moves.label: Sidestep Barrage Kick
moves.description: Fast high sidestep kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep command reuses the high Uzumaki Barrage kick.

moves.label: Sidestep Rasenshuriken
moves.description: Quick mid sidestep Rasenshuriken arc with strong tracking.
moves.reason: Sidestep command uses the mid Rasenshuriken arc.

moves.label: Running Rasenshuriken Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid running launcher with a short Rasenshuriken active window.
moves.reason: While-running Rasenshuriken is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: While-Rising Rasengan
moves.description: Fast high while-rising Rasengan palm with a brief active window.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the high Rasengan palm.

moves.label: While-Rising Jump Kick
moves.description: Quick mid jumping kick with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising kick is marked as a jump attack.

moves.label: Low Clone Jab
moves.description: Fast low clone jab with a tiny active window that ends in crouch.
moves.reason: Down jab is low and finishes in full crouch.

moves.label: Ducking Barrage Kick
moves.description: Fast high ducking kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down kick reuses the high Uzumaki Barrage kick.

moves.label: Diagonal Rasengan Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active Rasengan pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal Rasengan command is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Diagonal Barrage Kick
moves.description: Fast high diagonal kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal kick uses the high barrage kick animation.

moves.label: Forward Clone Strike
moves.description: Slow high clone strike with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command is a delayed high clone strike.

moves.label: Forward Rasengan Palm
moves.description: Fast high forward Rasengan palm with a brief active window.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the high Rasengan palm animation.

moves.label: Advancing Barrage Kick
moves.description: Fast high advancing kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward kick uses the high Uzumaki Barrage kick.

moves.label: Shadow Clone Rush Jab
moves.description: Fast high rush jab with a tiny active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab reuses the clone jab.

moves.label: Uzumaki Rush Kick
moves.description: Fast high rush kick with a short active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick uses the high barrage kick sequence.

moves.label: Rasenshuriken Tornado
moves.description: Steady mid Rasenshuriken tornado with a brief active window and strong tracking.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle Rasenshuriken carries tornado data.
